planets.name: Kepler-17 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-17 with a 1.49-day year, found in 2011.

text.card: Kepler-17 b was found in 2011 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Kepler-17. Its orbit and size follow TICv8's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname DESERT_ET_AL__2011): disc_year 2011, disc_facility Kepler, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 1.4857109944, pl_radj 1.31, pl_bmassj 2.45

thermal.source: Deming et al. 2023, dayside brightness temperature at 3.6 µm (uniform reanalysis of Spitzer's eclipses, CDS J/AJ/165/104 table 2)
thermal.chosen: 2 measured of 2 rows; the smallest relative uncertainty, then the longest wavelength
